sentences.japanese: 君は前と同じ誤りを犯した。
sentences.english: You made the same mistake as last time.

sentences.japanese: 君は、故意に間違いを犯したんだね。
sentences.english: You made the mistake on purpose, didn't you?

sentences.japanese: 飢えのために彼はやむなく罪を犯した。
sentences.english: It was hunger that impelled him to crime.

sentences.japanese: 間違いを犯して申し訳ありません。
sentences.english: I'm very sorry about the mistake.

sentences.japanese: 間違いを犯したということは我々は認めねばならない。
sentences.english: We must concede that we committed an error.
